{{Intro/Resonator|Qiuyuan|lang=zh=仇远}} Former senior agent of Mingting's Internal Security Agency, he is a swordsman of cool resilience and absolute integrity, wandering Huanglong alone and seeks not fame nor high office, but mastery of swordsmanship and a life guided by high morals. He was framed by the [[Grand Architect]] for the murder of his master, and is now a fugitive throughout all of [[Huanglong]].

==Trivia== 
===Etymology=== 
* Qiuyuan's name may be a reference to Qiu Yuan {{Lang|zh=仇远|zh_rm=Qiú Yuǎn}} (1247-1326), a famed calligrapher and poet, as well as a teacher in the Yuan dynasty. After he stopped teaching, he lived a reclusive life in the mountains.
* {{Lang|zh=仇|zh_rm=qiú}} is a Chinese surname.
** An alternative pronunciation of the same character, {{Lang|zh=仇|zh_rm=chóu}}, can mean "hatred; enmity; resentment".<ref>Wiktionary: [https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/%E4%BB%87 仇]</ref>
* {{Lang|zh-Hans=远|zh-Hans_rm=yuǎn}} is the simplified form of {{Lang|zh-Hant=遠|zh-Hant_rm=yuǎn}} meaning “distant; remote; far”.<ref>Wiktionary: [https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/%E9%81%A0 遠]</ref>
